title: Sakura: An Approach for Generating Complex Tests from Natural Language Test Descriptions
abstract: arXiv:2606.00530v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Research on automating software testing has spanned several decades. Most existing approaches generate unit tests for individual methods, validate isolated API endpoints, or target user interface (UI) layers, with non-API and non-UI generators typically exercising only a single focal method. Recent empirical evidence shows a substantial gap between such generated tests and developer-written ones, which often span several focal classes and methods, involve multi-step call sequences, and contain chained assertions, all characteristics that current approaches fail to capture. To address this gap, we propose generating tests from natural language (NL) descriptions of developer intent, an expressive and accessible medium for specifying complex test scenarios. translated_title: 樱：一种从自然语言测试描述生成复杂测试的方法
translated_abstract: 关于自动化软件测试的研究已持续数十年。现有的大多数方法为单个方法生成单元测试、验证孤立的API端点，或针对用户界面（UI）层，而非API和非UI的生成器通常只执行单个焦点方法。最近的实证证据表明，此类生成的测试与开发者编写的测试之间存在显著差距，后者通常涉及多个焦点类和方法、包含多步调用序列以及链式断言，而当前方法无法捕捉这些特征。为弥补这一差距，我们提出从开发者意图的自然语言（NL）描述中生成测试，这是一种表达性强且易于访问的媒介，用于指定复杂测试场景。我们介绍了Sakura，这是首个基于代理的框架，能够从自然语言描述中生成结构复杂的测试。Sakura将自然语言描述分解为结构化块，并处理...
tldr: 本文提出了Sakura，首个基于代理的框架，能够从自然语言描述中生成结构复杂的测试，解决了现有方法无法捕捉多类、多方法及链式断言等复杂测试特征的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Sakura, the first agent-based framework for generating structurally complex tests from natural language descriptions, addressing the gap where existing methods fail to capture multi-class, multi-method, and chained-assertion test characteristics.
